scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build && pnpm --filter @digihostel/api run verify:runtime-resolution
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:libs && pnpm -r --if-present run typecheck
